notes.title: 1.5.5.5 : Improvements
notes.content:
1.5.5.5 : Improvements

Network Code improved to reduce traffic, reduced bandwidth in places.

non RTX graphics card , default to 30 fps.

scene changes now take a tiny bit longer time to make sure they fully clear .

notes.title: 1.5.5.4 : Improved Radar + Dynamic Resolution
notes.content:
1.5.5.4 : Improved Radar + Dynamic Resolution

Radar now shows quest locations and portals from afar !

New Dynamic Resolution option (setting 4) will adjust to assist in achieving target framerate.

This is the new default for non RTX cards. TAA not as nice looking as DLSS so this will adjust only when you need it, rather than fixed resolution scaling setting defaults for RTX cards.

Also, fix to sub type bonus mitigation, eg. Armor vs Fire or poison, now functioning properly.

bonus damage reduced to +5 damage bonus per point from +10.

Some new craft recipes + items available.

Soulless Echo can now drop his Spear as Loot.

notes.title: 1.5.5.3 : Non DLSS Graphics Card changes
notes.content:
1.5.5.3 : Non RTX (DLSS) Graphics Card changes

Changed setup for Non RTX (DLSS) cards . 
Noticed a few Players crashing in some places without RTX cards, so this fixes a possible shader error.
Dynamic Resolution Scaling set to off by default, can use TAA by changing in-game settings.

notes.title: 1.5.4.5 : Auto Close Help Files
notes.content:
Help Files that popup at start of game will lock movement until they are closed by pressing F1.

Added a timer on these to auto close to prevent people being locked up forever if they don't spot the F1 close message.

notes.title: 1.5.4.4 : Hotfix Weapon FX
notes.content:
1.5.4.4 : Hotfix Weapon FX

Last night's update removed weapon FX (sword slash , ranged, specials).

This may have caused Player.log file bloating and slowed down play.

notes.title: 1.5.4.3 : Npc Camp Recruitment Changes
notes.content:
1.5.4.3 : Npc Camp Recruitment Changes

as before semi clears will increase rarity of reinforcements, but not by as much as full clears.

where mythic mobs are available the higher rarity chances will increase until mythic spawns , and following that mythics death , the camp will reset to all common. Clearing the camp will repeat the cycle.

Also fixed non visible right hand weapons.

notes.title: 1.5.4 : faster loot drops !
notes.content:
1.5.4 : faster loot drops !

faster npc death > loot time. no longer waits until dissolved to spawn loot boxes.

server fixes to npc behaviours, npc with offhand items (shield, heal , parry) had stopped using them , this fixed.

npc aggro reaction to ranged weapon attack when not in line of sight also fixed.
